details: Cryptocurrency markets experienced a modest recovery, with Bitcoin trading around $60,530-$61,200 and Ethereum near $1,704-$1,719, following a sharp sell-off last week. However, the broader market trend remains bearish due to continued significant outflows from Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs, totaling approximately $1.8 billion last week. Declining trading volumes and cautious institutional sentiment, alongside weakness in US technology stocks and Federal Reserve policy uncertainty, are weighing on risk appetite. While Bitcoin broke an 18-day streak of lower daily highs, signaling a potential easing of selling pressure, this does not yet confirm a bullish reversal.
title: Crypto Markets Recover Modestly Amid Bearish Trend and ETF Outflows

details: Bitcoin and the broader cryptocurrency markets rallied significantly, mirroring gains in tech stocks, after Nvidia's board announced the reinstatement of Jensen Huang as its CEO. Nvidia shares surged by 30%, driving a tech market rebound that positively impacted cryptocurrencies, which often correlate with tech stock performance. Following the news, Bitcoin climbed back above $63,000.
title: Nvidia CEO Reinstatement Sparks Crypto Market Rally

details: The U.S. Justice Department has filed a civil forfeiture complaint seeking to recover over $1.17 billion in USDC stablecoins that were stolen during the Binance hack on October 29, 2026. The attack is attributed to North Korean hackers. This legal action is the first formal step by the government to seize these assets, building on previous court orders that restrained over $1.2 billion. Circle, the issuer of USDC, facilitated the recovery efforts by freezing a substantial portion of the stolen funds.
title: US DOJ Moves to Recover $1.17 Billion in USDC from Binance Hack

details: Crypto news publication Decrypt has introduced "The Information Exchange," a new Solana-based platform that integrates news, market data, and live trading capabilities. This platform allows users to perform token swaps via Jupiter and engage in perpetual futures trading through Phoenix, aiming to streamline the process of reacting to market news with immediate trading actions.
title: Decrypt Launches Solana-Based "The Information Exchange"

details: Coinbase secured the top position in CoinDesk Research's November 2026 Exchange Benchmark, achieving a score of 91.16 out of 100. The report evaluated 62 centralized spot exchanges, a decrease from 75 in the previous assessment, indicating that 13 exchanges have exited the market due to closures and regulatory changes under Europe's MiCA framework. This marks the first time the overall average score across all exchanges has stalled after two consecutive periods of improvement.
title: Coinbase Leads CoinDesk Exchange Benchmark as Industry Consolidates

details: Cardano (ADA) has reached a significant technical milestone in its pursuit of enhanced network decentralization. Intersect, the organization overseeing the Cardano ecosystem, reported that five distinct node implementations successfully produced blocks on the Cardano mainnet. This achievement represents a step forward in reducing the network's reliance on a single software implementation. Ongoing preparations for the Dijkstra upgrade and continued testing of protocol version 12 are also underway.
title: Cardano Achieves Decentralization Milestone with Five Node Implementations

details: Bloomberg strategist Mike McGlone issued a warning that Bitcoin could see a significant drop to $10,000. He attributes this potential decline to the cryptocurrency bear market spreading to traditional assets and views Bitcoin's current downturn as a correction following years of excessive stimulus and speculation. McGlone suggests that any sharp, temporary rallies could be misleading for investors.
title: Strategist Warns Bitcoin Could Drop to $10,000

details: Zach Pandl, Head of Research at Grayscale, stated that Bitcoin and other major crypto assets appear "oversold" after last week's market downturn, which saw Bitcoin fall to approximately $55,000. However, Pandl emphasized that the near-term outlook for crypto markets is more influenced by AI-related risks than by blockchain fundamentals. He highlighted factors such as over $2 billion in weekly crypto ETP outflows and general caution surrounding AI investments as contributing to market uncertainty.
title: Grayscale: Bitcoin and Altcoins Look "Oversold" Amid AI Risks

details: Former President Donald Trump defended his foray into the cryptocurrency market at a private dinner for holders of his $TRUMP meme coin, asserting his actions aim to ensure the U.S. maintains a lead over China in the crypto space. This event occurred as the value of his associated meme coin continued to trade near record lows, dropping below $1. The dinner also underscored a substantial decrease in the collective value of tokens held by attendees compared to previous events, raising questions about potential conflicts of interest.
title: Trump Defends Crypto Involvement as Meme Coin Value Plunges
